headline: Youssef Nader rises from 1,830th to 21st on ARC-2

sections.text: Youssef Nader gained 25.83 points to reach 51.11, moving from 1,830th to 21st on the ARC-2 public board.
That rise brings Nader into the board’s top tier, after starting the day far down the standings.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
